The game does feel like, hey let's get together and play and have some fun time.
than let's get together and have this complicated tactical game going on
Round are fun, short, fast paced, pew pew, laugh and get to the next round.

First of all I want to say that the first time I played the game was with a mod that makes everything more intense and insane, But as chaotic as that was I really did get a lot out of the game.

Because we were playing the mod I don't really got a feel of how things play in terms o pacing,
didn't feel overwhelmed, but just because it was my first time playing
playing as the alien was making me feel very brittle and not knowing what I should do next
guns go pew pew pew, aliens are more tactical, but you are supposed to die often as the alien
since you are part of an ever incoming swarm of aliens.

First run was a bit more confusing because I was not accustomed to the geometry of the levels
but on the second run, the geometry of the level gets a bit more clear
giving the game more rounds will make it clear what you have to do, the learning curve isn't steep at all.
The in game messages (which you can see during play by pressing [Tab]) are super useful to know what you can do.

Really dig the sci-fi aesthetic, that is sooooo good!
Felt like defending DS9 from an invasion!

I recommend the game and also being part of it's community!

Admittedly, I have not given this game a lot of playtime, however some parts of the game are so lacking that I am not interested to invest any more time into it. The guns are B O R I N G. I don't know what it is, but they do not feel satisfying to shoot, maybe the sound design and the animations need improvement. Simply, it does not feel like you're shooting a gun. It feels like a toy bb gun. The hit sounds and hit animations are equally unsatisfying and don't give good feedback when a shot has hit or missed. Go compare to the weapons in Destiny 2 (it's free) to see an example of guns which feel substantial and satisfying to use.
Additionally, the enemies are equally boring. There are a few different types, but 95% of them are the same weak zombie, which is not at all threatening. And there are just tons and tons of them, swarming you. They're not scary, and it feels like there aren't consequences for sloppy gameplay. They just get annoying and tedious to kill.
Maybe I'm missing something, but to me this game was not even worth the sale price. It might be fun in the PvP gamemode though.

Feels like a game in alpha with a finalized artpass. I'll keep it in my library but it's a shame that it doesn't play as well as it looks. Kinda expected the characters to be funny and yapping all the time like in left 4 dead but they don't say anything besides gameplay callouts. A brute will come up and all they say is "it's a brute!" and then go back to being completely silent. I actually turned on subtitles expecting funny dialogue but it's dead silence 90 percent of the time. I'd put up with the boring gameplay if there was a good atmosphere with a funny cast of characters but I played for 25 minutes and didn't even get to meet any of them. Hoping that this game will get good someday or that the next game these guys make will be better

I'm not gonna sugarcoat it, the game is bad. The main problem is that everything feels like a placeholder.

I bet the folks at stray bombay will tell you "It's best when played with friends", but that stuff is so high up in hierarchy of needs, you still need an actual functional game underneath it.

If I put myself in their shoes, the first thing that would have to be tackled is the overall feel of the game. Add viewbob, do a whole pass on animations, remake Commons from scratch, add bullet penetration on pellets / consider replacing hitscan, either implement physics or just death animations (enemies just sort of slowly lump on ground, no momentum on ragdolls). That sort of thing.

The bad sound design is red herring (same goes other aspects). There are so many games you can totally play with your sound turned off. Now imagine you've fixed the audio – an audio engineer specialist has worked on it and it's amazing now, but that's the only thing that has been fixed. The game would still have a lot more important problems at hand.

Feel bad for the devs, but I can't recommend this game.
Unfortunately, the game is dead. And there isn't anything to do solo.
